questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML is HyperText Markup Language, the standard for web pages.

questions.question: Which tag creates a paragraph in HTML?
questions.explanation:
The

tag defines a paragraph in HTML documents.

questions.question: Which tag creates the largest heading?
questions.explanation: <h1> creates the largest heading, with <h6> being smallest.

questions.question: What tag creates a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The <a> anchor tag creates hyperlinks with the href attribute.

questions.question: Which attribute specifies the image source?
questions.explanation: The src attribute specifies the path to the image file.

questions.question: What tag creates an unordered list?
questions.explanation: <ul> creates unordered lists with bullet points.

questions.question: Which tag creates a line break?
questions.explanation:
The
tag inserts a line break without starting a new paragraph.

questions.question: What element contains metadata about the HTML document?
questions.explanation: The <head> element contains metadata like title and links.

questions.question: Which tag makes text bold?
questions.explanation: Both <b> and <strong> make text bold, though <strong> adds semantic meaning.

questions.question: What tag creates a table in HTML?
questions.explanation: The <table> tag creates tables with rows and columns.

questions.question: Which tag creates a numbered list?
questions.explanation: <ol> creates ordered lists with numbered items.

questions.question: Which attribute specifies a hyperlink's destination URL?
questions.explanation: The href attribute on the <a> tag sets the link destination.

questions.question: Which tag creates a horizontal line across the page?
questions.explanation: The <hr> tag inserts a thematic horizontal rule.

questions.question: Which element contains all visible content of a web page?
questions.explanation: The <body> element holds all rendered page content.

questions.question: Which tag makes text italic?
questions.explanation: Both <i> and <em> render italic text, though <em> adds semantic emphasis.

questions.question: Which element sets the title shown in the browser tab?
questions.explanation: The <title> element inside <head> labels the browser tab.

questions.question: Which tag creates a dropdown list of choices?
questions.explanation: <select> builds dropdown menus with <option> children.

questions.question: Which attribute value opens a link in a new browser tab?
questions.explanation: target="_blank" forces links to open in a new tab.

questions.question: Which element embeds JavaScript code in an HTML page?
questions.explanation: The <script> tag embeds or links JavaScript code.

questions.question: Which tag links an external CSS stylesheet?
questions.explanation: <link rel="stylesheet"> attaches external CSS files.

questions.question: Which element creates a multi-line text input field?
questions.explanation: <textarea> accepts multiple lines of user text.

questions.question: What does <!DOCTYPE html> declare?
options: The page imports the HTML library
It links to the HTML stylesheet
questions.explanation: <!DOCTYPE html> tells browsers the document follows HTML5.

questions.question: Which syntax creates an HTML comment?
questions.explanation: HTML comments are wrapped in <!-- and -->.

questions.question: Which attribute makes a table cell span multiple columns?
questions.explanation: colspan merges a cell across columns; rowspan works on rows.

questions.question: Which HTML5 element plays audio files?
questions.explanation: The <audio> element embeds sound with playback controls.

questions.question: Which of these elements is empty, having no closing tag?
questions.explanation: is a void element with no closing tag.
